reason: Clinical treatment, professional medical practice or health-insurance benefit administration does not regulate residential physical work, occupancy or outgoing-account resolution. Conditional residential-care housing remains separately retained; this exclusion is confined to the named clinical/insurance subject.

School instruction, credentials, institution governance, workforce training or education procurement is outside the residential work/account aperture. Student housing, property-leasing requirements and mixed education budget acts remain separately selected.

Species designation, wildlife/fisheries administration or ecosystem conservation with no residential work permission indicated by the specific heading is outside the aperture. Generally applicable environmental and protected-species constraints remain selected separately.

Named generation, transmission, transport, industrial or geographically specific public infrastructure project/program does not supply a residential repair or customer-service rule. General utility service, rates, building electrification, local permitting and mixed public-resource acts remain selected separately.

Standalone pet sale, nonresidential retail permitting, private storage rental or consumer-product sector regulation is outside turnover of residential premises. Tenant pet policies, residential consumer rights and abandoned-property disposal remain separately retained.

The specific public-office, criminal-custody, employment-benefit or individual-tax administration topic does not alter residential work or outgoing accounts. General civil remedies, resident protections and contractor liability remain retained.

Specific education, medical treatment/insurance, adult-content platform, retail ticketing or criminal sector subject does not govern residential work, occupancy, account recovery or general civil procedure.

The enactment is expressly limited to a named locality, entity or property outside Orange County/Huntington Beach. General California enabling requirements and statewide conditional housing regimes remain selected. Reopen this local act if that geography enters scope.
